name: @gian/desktop
description: macOS desktop shell for the Gian coding agent workspace
author: RichLogic

scripts.test:smoke: node ../../scripts/execution-policy.mjs desktop && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:smoke:run
scripts.dev: node ../../scripts/execution-policy.mjs desktop && pnpm run build && electron .
scripts.bundle:build: node ../../scripts/prepare-desktop-runtime.mjs && pnpm --filter @gian/dsh-bridge build && pnpm --filter @gian/desktop... build && pnpm --filter @gian/web build
scripts.package:mac: node ../../scripts/execution-policy.mjs package && pnpm run bundle:build && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --publish never
scripts.make:mac: node ../../scripts/execution-policy.mjs package && pnpm run bundle:build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.make:mac:release: node ../../scripts/execution-policy.mjs package && node -e "for (const name of ['CSC_KEYCHAIN','APPLE_API_KEY','APPLE_API_KEY_ID','APPLE_API_ISSUER','GIAN_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID']) if (!process.env[name]) throw new Error('Missing release environment: ' + name)" && pnpm run bundle:build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --config.forceCodeSigning=true --config.mac.notarize=true --config.extraMetadata.gianReleaseChannel=stable --publish never && pnpm run verify:update-artifacts
